findings.desc: quality-cleanup: auto-commit-metadata.ts:14 JSDoc says storyId must match /^B-[a-f0-9]{4}$/ but the actual runtime pattern at line 62 is /^B-[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]*$/. The doc is stale from the original production-only pattern and diverges from what the code actually accepts. A reader relying on the JSDoc would think B-test1 or B-init-authority are invalid IDs, but they are not.

quality-cleanup: auto-commit-metadata.ts:73-81 assertCanonicalStoryRel is a dead assertion that can never fire. At line 150 storyRel is computed as AUTO_COMMIT_STORY_DIR_PREFIX + storyId, and at line 74 expected is also computed as AUTO_COMMIT_STORY_DIR_PREFIX + storyId — they are always the same string. The function exists because the old story-advance caller passed a storyDirRel parameter (line 475 of the deleted code), making the assertion meaningful. Now that the path is hardcoded inside the helper, the assert is tautological dead code and misleads readers into thinking the path could diverge.
